shortDescription: Create, Update or Destroy a Managed Instance Group (MIG).

options.name: autoscaling
options.description: A dictionary of configuration for the autoscaler. 'enabled (bool)', 'name (str)' and policy.max_instances (int) are required fields if autoscaling is used. See U(https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/reference/beta/autoscalers) for more information on Autoscaling.

options.name: credentials_file
options.description: Path to the JSON file associated with the service account email

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Managed Instance Group.

options.name: named_ports
options.description: Define named ports that backend services can forward data to.  Format is a a list of name:port dictionaries.

options.name: pem_file
options.description: path to the pem file associated with the service account email This option is deprecated. Use 'credentials_file'.

options.name: size
options.description: Size of Managed Instance Group.  If MIG already exists, it will be resized to the number provided here.  Required for creating MIGs.

options.name: template
options.description: Instance Template to be used in creating the VMs.  See U(https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/instance-templates) to learn more about Instance Templates.  Required for creating MIGs.

options.name: zone
options.description: The GCE zone to use for this Managed Instance Group.
